shared_elements: possible schematic anthropomorphic or face-like forms
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces include schematic carved/incised linear designs with some circular or disc-like elements, and possibly very simplified human/face-like signs. The biggest difference is that B is dominated by a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with facial and torso features, while A appears as a spread-out panel of faint geometric/register-like and possibly animal or sign motifs rather than the same iconographic scheme.
